task: Restore Fast Debug exact indexed-read authority for take selector fixtures on integrated Phase 28 source.
observation: The 16/18 take harness regression was limited to conditions whose exact Index receiver was a projected EST expression (`c.slots` or `r.groups[0].tasks`). The checker producer only published facts when Index.base itself was an Identifier, silently skipping these occurrences while the Fast Debug consumer correctly failed closed.
impact: Using the exact receiver ExprId span and checker TypeEnv type for a receiver rooted in the local/parameter binding closes the gap without selecting semantics from runtime values or weakening consumer checks. Default and Shadow both pass the full 18-case take harness, and added fact corruption probes fail closed on both formerly failing projected receiver shapes.

resolution.summary: Implementation passes focused Default/Shadow gates; independent review remains pending.

tool_used: Phase 28 take harness in Default and EST-shadow with corruption hooks
